accountIds.description: Only return accounting entries that match with the given account IDs.

bookkeepingDateEnd.description: Return accounting entries that have been recorded prior to the specific bookkeeping date. This value cannot be used with other date search criteria.

bookkeepingDateStart.description: Return accounting entries that have been recorded after the specific bookkeeping date. This value cannot be used with any other date search criteria.

employeeIds.description: Only return accounting entries that match with the specific Employee ID.

exportStatus.description: Only return accounting entries that match with the specific export status.

families.description: Only return accounting entries that belong to the specific accounting entry families

foreignExtensionIds.description: Only return accounting entries with the given `foreignExtensionId`. This is an auto-generated ID that populates when the Accounting Entries API endpoints interact with other Pleo APIs.'

hasAccount.description: Only return accounting entries with an Account ID assigned

hasBookkeepingDate.description: Only return Accounting Entries that have bookkeeping date set

hasNote.description: Return accounting entries that have a note

performedAtEnd.description: Only return accounting entries performed before this date. Cannot be used with any other date filters

performedAtStart.description: Only return accounting entries performed after this date. Cannot be used with any other date filters

reviewStatus.description: Only return accounting entries that match with the specific review status.

settled.description: Only return accounting entries that have a settled status.

settledAtEnd.description: Only return accounting entries settled before this date. Cannot be used with any other date filters

settledAtStart.description: Only return accounting entries settled after this date. Cannot be used with any other date filters

status.description: Only return accounting entries that match with the specific accounting entry status.

subFamilies.description: Only return accounting entries that belong to the specific sub family.

tagGroupIdsUnset.description: Only return accounting entries where the given Tag Group IDs do not have a tag value set.

tagRowIds.description: Only return accounting entries with the given Tag ID.

taxCodeIds.description: Only return accounting entries that match with the specific tax code IDs

teamIds.description: Only return accounting entries with the given Team ID. The Team ID is not the one allocated to an employee, It is allocated to a team of a company. For example, an accounting entry contains the team ID of Design team as the specific entry is associated with the Design team

transactionValueCurrencies.description: Only return accounting entries with the given transaction currency codes (ISO 4217). Filters on the original transaction currency of the expense.
